questions.q: Choose the word that is most nearly SAME in meaning to: OBSOLETE
questions.x: 'Obsolete' means outdated. 'Modern' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Benevolent'.
questions.x: 'Benevolent' means kind-hearted. 'Malicious' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The reason why he failed / is because / he did not prepare.
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'is because'. 'The reason… is that'; 'because' is redundant.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To throw in the towel' mean?
questions.x: 'To throw in the towel' means: to admit defeat.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
He returned back / to his hometown / after retirement.
questions.x: The error is in part (a): 'He returned back'. 'Returned back' is redundant: use 'returned'.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'Killing of one's own father'
questions.x: 'Patricide' means killing of one's own father.

questions.q: Select the antonym of the word 'Obstinate'.
questions.x: 'Obstinate' is the opposite of 'Flexible'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Obstinate'.

questions.q: The two departments have agreed to ____ their resources for the project.
questions.x: 'Pool' means to combine.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: CORDIAL
questions.x: 'Cordial' is the opposite of 'Hostile'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Cordial'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To be in the limelight' mean?
o: To be the centre of public attention
To be on stage lighting duty
questions.x: 'To be in the limelight' means: to be the centre of public attention.

questions.q: According to the passage, what happens to output per hour after a point?
o: It falls sharply because of fatigue
questions.x: Answer: 'It falls sharply because of fatigue'. The second sentence states this. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Long working hours are often mistaken for high productivity. Studies of factories and offices show that output per hour falls sharply after a point, as fatigue increases errors and accidents. Rested workers make better decisions and stay longer with their employers. A workplace that values results rather than hours spent at the desk tends to be both more humane and more efficient.

questions.q: The author believes a good workplace values:
o: Results rather than hours spent at the desk
questions.x: Answer: 'Results rather than hours spent at the desk'. The last sentence states this view. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: Long working hours are often mistaken for high productivity. Studies of factories and offices show that output per hour falls sharply after a point, as fatigue increases errors and accidents. Rested workers make better decisions and stay longer with their employers. A workplace that values results rather than hours spent at the desk tends to be both more humane and more efficient.

questions.q: Who was the Viceroy of India at the time of the foundation of the Indian National Congress (1885)?
questions.x: Lord Dufferin was Viceroy during the foundation of the Indian National Congress (1885).

questions.q: Who led the 'Red Shirts' (Khudai Khidmatgars) in the North-West Frontier during Civil Disobedience?
questions.x: Correct answer: Khan Abdul Ghaffar Khan. He was called 'Frontier Gandhi'.

questions.q: Lord Ripon is remembered for:
o: The Resolution on Local Self-Government (1882) and the Ilbert Bill
questions.x: Ripon repealed the Vernacular Press Act (1882) and is called the 'father of local self-government'.

questions.q: The Partition of Bengal (1905) was announced by:
questions.x: It was justified on administrative grounds but seen as an attempt to divide Hindus and Muslims.

questions.q: Which of the following famines led to the Famine Commission under Richard Strachey (1880)?
questions.x: Correct answer: The Great Famine of 1876–78. It recommended a Famine Code.

questions.q: The Chittagong armoury raid led by Surya Sen took place — this happened in the year:
questions.x: The Chittagong armoury raid led by Surya Sen took place in 1930. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: The Lahore Resolution demanding separate states for Muslims was passed in:
questions.x: It is also called the Pakistan Resolution (23 March 1940).

questions.q: Who among the following represented the 'depressed classes' at all three Round Table Conferences?
questions.x: Ambedkar's demand for separate electorates led to the Communal Award and then the Poona Pact.

questions.q: Who founded the Self-Respect Movement?
questions.x: The Self-Respect Movement was founded by E. V. Ramasamy (Periyar).

questions.q: The newspaper/journal 'Al-Hilal' is associated with:
o: Sisir Kumar Ghosh and Motilal Ghosh
questions.x: 'Al-Hilal' was started/edited by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.

questions.q: Which day is observed on 4 December?
o: National Science Day (discovery of the Raman effect)
questions.x: 4 December is Indian Navy Day.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about Chandrayaan-3:
1. It carried a lander and a rover.
2. It carried an orbiter with scientific instruments for long-term lunar study.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.x:
Statement 1 is correct; Statement 2 is incorrect.
Chandrayaan-3 had a propulsion module (carrying a SHAPE payload), a lander (Vikram) and a rover (Pragyan); it did not carry a new orbiter like Chandrayaan-2.

questions.q: 'AMRUT' mission is focused on:
o: Water supply and sewerage in urban areas
questions.x: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation was launched in 2015.

questions.q: In 2025, which serial property was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List?
questions.x: Correct answer: Maratha Military Landscapes of India. It comprises twelve forts in Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: COP28 (2023), which operationalised the Loss and Damage Fund, was held in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Dubai, UAE. COP27 in Sharm el-Sheikh had agreed to create the fund.

questions.q: The 'Pradhanmantri Sangrahalaya' in New Delhi is a museum dedicated to:
questions.x: Correct answer: All Prime Ministers of India. It was inaugurated in April 2022 at Teen Murti.

questions.q: Which of the following organisations is headquartered in Jakarta?
questions.x: ASEAN Secretariat is based in Jakarta.

questions.q: 'Operation Ajay' (2023) was launched to evacuate Indian nationals from:
questions.x: 'Operation Kaveri' (2023) evacuated Indians from Sudan; 'Operation Ganga' (2022) from Ukraine.

questions.q: Who among the following was NOT conferred the Bharat Ratna in 2024?
questions.x: The 2024 awardees were Karpoori Thakur, L. K. Advani, P. V. Narasimha Rao, Chaudhary Charan Singh and M. S. Swaminathan. Vajpayee received it in 2015.

questions.q: Divya Deshmukh won the FIDE Women's World Cup in July 2025, defeating in an all-Indian final:
questions.x: Correct answer: Koneru Humpy. She also earned the Grandmaster title with the win.

questions.q: A joint sitting of the two Houses CANNOT be held for:
o: A financial bill other than a money bill
A Money Bill or a Constitution Amendment Bill
A bill passed by one House and rejected by the other
questions.x: Money bills need only Lok Sabha approval; amendment bills must be passed by each House separately.

questions.q: The Fifteenth Finance Commission recommended what share of the divisible pool of central taxes for States (2021–26)?
questions.x: The 14th FC had recommended 42%; the 15th reduced it to 41% after the creation of the UT of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.

questions.q: Article 48A of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Superintendence, direction and control of elections vested in an Election Commission
Power of the Governor to promulgate Ordinances
Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wildlife
questions.x: Article 48A: Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wildlife.

questions.q: Which constitutional amendment added Bodo, Dogri, Maithili and Santhali to the Eighth Schedule?
questions.x: It was the 92nd Amendment Act of 2003.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Raising the level of nutrition and public health; prohibition of intoxicating drinks"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 47.

questions.q: Which Article prohibits discrimination in public employment but allows reservation for backward classes?
questions.x: Article 16(4) permits reservation in appointments for backward classes inadequately represented.

questions.q: Residuary powers of legislation in India are vested in:
questions.x: Correct answer: Parliament (Article 248). Unlike the USA, residuary powers rest with the Union.

questions.q: Which day is celebrated as National Panchayati Raj Day?
questions.x: The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993.

questions.q: Public Interest Litigation (PIL) in India is associated with relaxation of the rule of:
questions.x: Justices P. N. Bhagwati and V. R. Krishna Iyer pioneered PIL in the late 1970s and 1980s.

questions.q: The Cabinet Secretariat functions under the direct charge of the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Prime Minister. The Cabinet Secretary is the senior-most civil servant.

questions.q: The main thrust of the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–78) was:
o: Doubling per capita income in ten years; monitorable targets
Self-reliant and self-generating economy; disrupted by wars and drought, followed by plan holidays
Removal of poverty (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance; terminated early
Rapid industrialisation with heavy industries, based on the Mahalanobis model
questions.x: Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974–78): Removal of poverty (Garibi Hatao) and self-reliance; terminated early.

questions.q: 'Reserve money' (M0) includes:
o: Currency in circulation, bankers' deposits with the RBI and other deposits with the RBI
questions.x: Correct answer: Currency in circulation, bankers' deposits with the RBI and other deposits with the RBI. It is also called high-powered money.

questions.q: A 'progressive' tax is one in which:
o: The rate falls as income rises
The tax rate rises as income rises
questions.x: Correct answer: The tax rate rises as income rises. Income tax slabs in India are progressive.

questions.q: A fixed deposit pays 9% per annum while inflation is 5%. Using the Fisher approximation, the real rate of interest is about:
questions.x:
Fisher approximation: real rate ≈ nominal rate − inflation = 9 − 5 = 4%.
(Exact: (1.09/1.05 − 1) × 100 ≈ 3.81%.)

questions.q: The Sustainable Development Goals, numbering 17, are to be achieved by:
questions.x: Correct answer: 2030. They were adopted by the UN in 2015, succeeding the MDGs.

questions.q: 'Dumping' in international trade refers to:
o: Exporting goods at a price lower than in the home market
questions.x: Anti-dumping duties are imposed by the importing country to counter it.

questions.q:
In which year did the following happen?
The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code was enacted.
questions.x: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code was enacted in 2016.

questions.q:
Consider the following taxes:
1. Personal income tax
2. Corporation tax
3. GST
4. Customs duty
How many of the above are direct taxes?
questions.x:
2 of the 4 listed items satisfy the condition asked.
Income tax and corporation tax are direct; GST and customs are indirect.

questions.q: 'Engel's law' states that as income rises:
o: The proportion of income spent on food falls
questions.x: Correct answer: The proportion of income spent on food falls. It helps measure welfare and poverty.

questions.q: A loan account becomes a Non-Performing Asset (NPA) when interest or principal remains overdue for more than:
questions.x: Correct answer: 90 days. Assets are further classified as substandard, doubtful and loss.

questions.q: A trader's capital at the beginning of the year was ₹80,000 and at the end ₹1,85,000. During the year he introduced fresh capital of ₹25,000 and withdrew ₹5,000 for personal use. His profit for the year is:
questions.x:
Profit = Closing capital + Drawings − Additional capital − Opening capital
= 1,85,000 + 5,000 − 25,000 − 80,000 = ₹85,000 (statement of affairs method).

questions.q: Purchases during a month: 1st — 100 units @ ₹19; 10th — 100 units @ ₹23; 20th — 100 units @ ₹27. 200 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 100 units left come from the latest purchases: 100 × ₹27 = ₹2,700.

questions.q: The interest coverage ratio is:
questions.x: Correct answer: EBIT ÷ Interest on long-term debt. It shows how many times profits cover interest charges.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹1,60,000 is depreciated at 20% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 3 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 1,60,000 × (0.8)^3 = ₹81,920.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹64,000.)

questions.q: The statutory auditor of a company is appointed under the Companies Act, 2013 at the AGM for a term of:
o: Five years (from one AGM to the sixth AGM)
questions.x: Correct answer: Five years (from one AGM to the sixth AGM). Section 139; rotation norms apply to listed and certain companies.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 3 : 2. They admit R for a 1/8 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
Closing stock given as an adjustment outside the trial balance is shown:
o: On the credit side of the trading account and as an asset in the balance sheet
questions.x: Correct answer: On the credit side of the trading account and as an asset in the balance sheet. Every adjustment has a double effect.

questions.q: Manufacturing wages are shown in the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Trading (or manufacturing) account. Wages directly related to production are direct expenses.

questions.q: Opening inventory is ₹55,000, closing inventory is ₹95,000 and cost of goods sold for the year is ₹4,50,000. The inventory turnover ratio is:
questions.x:
Average inventory = (55,000 + 95,000) / 2 = ₹75,000.
Inventory turnover = COGS / Average inventory = 4,50,000 / 75,000 = 6 times.

questions.q: 'Anticipate no profit but provide for all possible losses' expresses the convention of:
questions.x: Valuing inventory at cost or net realisable value, whichever is lower, is an application.

questions.q: From the following, compute Gross Profit: Opening stock ₹55,000; Purchases ₹3,50,000; Purchase returns ₹1,000; Carriage inwards ₹3,000; Sales ₹4,47,000; Sales returns ₹3,000; Closing stock ₹25,000.
questions.x:
Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases − Purchase returns + Carriage inwards − Closing stock
= 55,000 + 3,50,000 − 1,000 + 3,000 − 25,000 = ₹3,82,000.
Gross profit = Net sales − COGS = 4,47,000 − 3,000 − 3,82,000 = ₹62,000.
Carriage inwards is a direct expense (Trading A/c).

questions.q: Insurance premium paid in advance is adjusted by:
o: Insurance A/c Dr. To Prepaid Insurance A/c
Insurance A/c Dr. To Cash A/c
Prepaid Insurance A/c Dr. To Insurance A/c
Cash A/c Dr. To Prepaid Insurance A/c
questions.x: Correct answer: Prepaid Insurance A/c Dr. To Insurance A/c. The unexpired portion becomes an asset; the expense is reduced.

questions.q: A delivery van is purchased for ₹4,50,000 and ₹12,000 is spent on its installation. Its estimated useful life is 10 years with a residual value of ₹16,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (4,50,000 + 12,000 − 16,000) / 10 = 4,46,000 / 10 = ₹44,600 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: In the absence of a partnership deed, interest on partners' capital is:
questions.x: Correct answer: Not allowed. No interest on capital unless agreed.

questions.q: 'Kaizen' is a Japanese management philosophy emphasising:
questions.x: Correct answer: Continuous, incremental improvement. Kaizen involves all employees in small, ongoing improvements.

questions.q: Each member state's delegation to the International Labour Conference comprises:
o: Two employer and two worker delegates
Two government delegates, one employer delegate and one worker delegate
One delegate each from government, employers and workers
questions.x: The 2:1:1 composition gives governments half the votes while social partners vote independently.

questions.q: Which State was the first to enact a law for registration and welfare of platform-based gig workers (2023)?
questions.x: The Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act, 2023 was the first such state law; Karnataka followed in 2025.

questions.q: Identify the year of enactment of the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act.
questions.x: The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act was enacted in 1986.

questions.q: The 'subsistence theory' or 'iron law of wages' holds that wages tend towards:
o: The minimum needed for workers to survive and reproduce
The level fixed by trade unions
questions.x: Associated with Ricardo and Lassalle, it argued population growth pushes wages to subsistence.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, the spread-over of working hours of a worker in a day (including rest intervals) ordinarily cannot exceed:
questions.x: Spread-over including intervals is limited (10.5 hours under the Factories Act; the Code empowers rules within similar limits).

questions.q: Under the Code on Wages, minimum wages are normally fixed by reference to all of the following time units EXCEPT:
questions.x: Minimum wages may be fixed by time (hour, day, month) or by piece. A dividend-based rate is not a wage concept.

questions.q: 'Picketing' in labour disputes refers to:
o: Workers stationing themselves at the workplace entrance to dissuade others from working
questions.x: Peaceful picketing may be lawful; violent picketing or intimidation is not.

questions.q: Which international covenant recognises in Article 9 'the right of everyone to social security, including social insurance'?
o: Convention on the Rights of the Child (1989)
International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (1966)
International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (1966)
questions.x: ICESCR Article 9 recognises the right to social security; India acceded to ICESCR in 1979.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, a trade union can be registered if it has as members at least:
o: 20% of the workers or 300 workers, whichever is more
10% of the workers or 100 workers, whichever is less, subject to a minimum of 7
7 workers irrespective of the size of the establishment
questions.x: Section 6 of the IR Code: no union is registered unless at least 10% of workers or 100 workers (whichever is less) are members, with at least seven members on the date of application.

questions.q: Which case held that termination of a workman's service for non-observance of statutory conditions precedent to retrenchment is void ab initio?
o: State Bank of India v. N. Sundara Money (1976)
questions.x: Sundara Money gave 'retrenchment' a wide meaning covering termination for any reason other than punishment; non-compliance with Section 25F rendered it void.

questions.q: If the labour force of a region is 50 lakh and 46 lakh people are employed, the unemployment rate is:
questions.x: Unemployed = 50 − 46 = 4 lakh; UR = 4/50 × 100 = 8%.

questions.q: The Shram Suvidha portal (2014) allots each establishment a:
o: Goods and Services Tax Identification Number
questions.x: The portal unified registration and returns under several labour laws and allotted a unique LIN.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, 'appropriate government' for an industrial establishment run by a State Government department is:
questions.x: Establishments under the State's control fall under the State Government.

questions.q: The Ministry of Labour and Employment's 'Shramev Jayate' initiatives (2014) included:
o: Portable UAN for EPF members and a transparent labour inspection scheme
questions.x: Shramev Jayate (October 2014) launched UAN, the Shram Suvidha portal, random inspection scheme and apprenticeship protsahan yojana.

questions.q: The presiding officer of the Internal Committee under the POSH Act must be:
o: A woman employed at a senior level in the workplace
questions.x: The presiding officer must be a woman employed at a senior level; at least half the members must be women and one member is from an NGO or person familiar with women's issues.

questions.q: An EPF member's employer contributes 12% on ₹15,000. The EDLI contribution by the employer is:
The minimum assurance benefit under the EDLI Scheme is:
questions.x: Minimum ₹2.5 lakh applies when the member has been in continuous employment as specified; amendments in 2025 provide a smaller minimum for very short service.

questions.q: Maternity benefit under the ESI scheme is paid at:
questions.x: ESI maternity benefit is full wages for 26 weeks, extendable by one month on medical advice.

questions.q: Social security for unorganised workers under the Code on Social Security is to be financed through the Social Security Fund using all of the following sources EXCEPT:
o: Compulsory deduction of 12% from the wages of every unorganised worker
questions.x: The Fund draws on aggregator contributions, government grants, CSR and other sources; there is no mandatory 12% wage deduction for unorganised workers.

questions.q: EPFO is one of the largest social security organisations in the world in terms of:
o: Number of members and volume of financial transactions
questions.x: EPFO manages accounts of crores of members and processes large volumes of claims annually.

questions.q: The EPF interest rate declared for 2023–24 and retained for 2024–25 is:
questions.x: 8.25% was declared for 2023–24 and retained for 2024–25; 2022–23 was 8.15% and 2021–22 was 8.10%.

questions.q: Both PMJJBY and PMSBY are offered through:
o: Banks and post offices with auto-debit from savings accounts
questions.x: Subscribers enrol through their bank/post office account; premiums are auto-debited annually.

questions.q: Which of the following is the best example of a 'contributory' social security scheme in India?
o: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
questions.x: EPF is funded by employer and employee contributions; the others are tax-financed.

questions.q: An employee's monthly basic wages plus DA are ₹14,500. Of the employer's 12% contribution, how much is credited to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) account?
questions.x:
Employer's 12% = ₹1,740. Of this, 8.33% of wages (on a wage ceiling of ₹15,000) goes to EPS: 8.33% × 14,500 = ₹1,208.
The balance ₹532 (3.67%) goes to the EPF account. The employee's own 12% (₹1,740) goes entirely to EPF.

questions.q: Employees whose average daily wage is up to what amount are exempt from paying their own ESI contribution?
questions.x: Low-paid employees earning up to ₹176 a day (average) do not pay the 0.75% share; the employer still pays 3.25%.

questions.q: 'Old-age dependency ratio' is generally defined as:
o: Population aged 65+ per 100 persons of working age (15–64)
questions.x: Correct answer: Population aged 65+ per 100 persons of working age (15–64). A rising ratio strains PAYG pensions and health systems.

questions.q: A woman employee entitled to 26 weeks of maternity benefit has an average daily wage of ₹610. Following the Supreme Court's view in B. Shah v. Presiding Officer (1977) that the benefit covers all days of the period, the total maternity benefit is:
questions.x:
The benefit is paid for every day of the 26-week period including Sundays: 26 × 7 = 182 days.
Amount = ₹610 × 182 = ₹1,11,020. (Using 6 days/week would wrongly give ₹95,160.)

questions.q: Neutron is credited to:
questions.x: Neutron: James Chadwick.

questions.q: 'Spreadsheet' software is mainly used for:
o: Calculations, data analysis and charts in rows and columns
questions.x: Correct answer: Calculations, data analysis and charts in rows and columns. MS Excel and Google Sheets are examples.

questions.q: 'Mail Merge' in MS Word is used to:
o: Create personalised letters or labels for many recipients from a data list
Send email directly from Word only
questions.x: It combines a main document with a data source such as an Excel sheet.

questions.q: In MS Excel, a cell reference like $A$1 is an example of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Absolute reference. It does not change when copied.

questions.q: 1 kilobyte (in binary convention) is equal to:
questions.x: Correct answer: 1,024 bytes. 1 KB = 2¹⁰ bytes; 1 MB = 1,024 KB.

questions.q: The 'Coulomb' is the SI unit of:
questions.x: Coulomb measures electric charge.

questions.q: The chemical name/formula of 'slaked lime' is:
questions.x: Slaked lime = Ca(OH)₂ (calcium hydroxide).

questions.q: Which abbreviation stands for 'Basic Input/Output System'?
questions.x: Basic Input/Output System is abbreviated as BIOS.

questions.q: Tides in the oceans are caused mainly by:
o: The gravitational pull of the Moon (and Sun)
questions.x: Correct answer: The gravitational pull of the Moon (and Sun). Spring tides occur at full and new moon.

questions.q: Vinegar contains:
questions.x: Ant stings contain formic acid; curd contains lactic acid; lemons contain citric acid.

questions.q: Which blood cells help in clotting?
questions.x: Correct answer: Platelets. WBCs fight infection.

questions.q: Which of the following is a good conductor of electricity?
questions.x: Silver is the best conductor; copper is widely used due to cost.

questions.q: The marks of students are: 20, 59, 79, 10, 91, 66, 21. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 346; number of values = 7. Mean = 346/7 = 49.43.

questions.q:
Members enrolled in a district (thousand) — 2020: 275  |  2021: 320  |  2022: 305  |  2023: 355  |  2024: 370.
What is the percentage change from 2022 to 2024?
questions.x:
Change = 370 − 305 = 65 on a base of 305 (earlier year).
% change = 65/305 × 100 = 21.31% → 21.31% increase.

questions.q: The ratio of the present ages of P and Q is 2 : 7. After 11 years, the ratio will become 27 : 67. What is P's present age?
The average of 11 observations is 46. The average of the first 6 is 45 and that of the last 6 is 42. The 6th observation is:
questions.x:
Sum of all 11 = 11 × 46 = 506.
First 6 + last 6 = 6×45 + 6×42 = 522; the middle observation is counted twice.
Middle = 522 − 506 = 16.

questions.q: The monthly salary of a clerk is first raised by 30% and the new value is then reduced by 30%. Compared with the original, the final value shows a:
questions.x:
Successive change formula: net % = a + b + ab/100 with a = +30, b = −30.
Net = 30 − 30 − (30×30)/100 = −9%.
An equal rise and fall always ends in a loss of (x²/100)%. So it is a 9% decrease.

questions.q: The difference between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 15% per annum is ₹438.75. The sum is:
24 September 1997 was a Wednesday. What day of the week was 24 September 2003?
questions.x:
Each ordinary year shifts the day by 1, and a leap day (29 Feb) crossed in between adds 1 more.
Total days between the dates = 2191 = 313 weeks + 0 odd days.
Wednesday + 0 = Wednesday.

questions.q: In what ratio must sugar costing ₹60 per kg be mixed with sugar costing ₹180 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹154 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (180 − 154) : (154 − 60) = 26 : 94 = 13 : 47.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: Find the unit digit of 38^92 × 62^74.
questions.x:
Only last digits matter.
Unit digit of first term (base ending 8, cycle 8,4,2,6; 92 → position 4) = 6.
Unit digit of second term (base ending 2, cycle 2,4,8,6; 74 → position 2) = 4.
6 × 4 → unit digit 4.

questions.q: A train 280 m long running at 54 km/h crosses a platform in 29 seconds. The length of the platform is:
questions.x:
Speed = 54 × 5/18 = 15 m/s. Distance covered in 29 s = 435 m = train + platform.
Platform = 435 − 280 = 155 m.

questions.q: Find the volume of a cylindrical water tank of radius 21 m and height 29 m. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.x:
V = πr²h = (22/7) × 21 × 21 × 29 = 40194 m³.
(Curved surface 2πrh would be 3828 m² — a common mix-up.)

questions.q: Find the odd one out among 234, 117, 237 and 260.
questions.x: 234, 260, 117 are all multiples of 13; 237 is not. Hence 237 is the odd one out.

questions.q: In how many ways can the letters of the word 'ARREARS' be arranged so that all the vowels always come together?
questions.x:
Vowels: A, E, A; consonants: R, R, R, S.
Treat the vowels as one block → 5 units → 20 arrangements (R appears 3 times).
Vowels inside the block: 3 ways (A appears 2 times).
Total = 20 × 3 = 60.
